## Type of Change

- [ ] Bug fix

## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run typecheck` passes
- [ ] `npm run lint` passes, with no new warnings in the files you changed
- [ ] New and changed code follows `docs/CODE_GUIDE.md` (review checklist at the end of the guide)
- [ ] Tested on iOS or Android
- [ ] Updated README if needed
